Things I've built.

  • QuestPass

    An event engagement platform launched at Devcon 8 Mumbai: 65+ attendee passes from 30+ cities and 138 side events and stamp spots. QR connect with consent-based contact sharing, a filterable People directory, organiser event submissions with Luma and CSV imports, and an NFC stamp hunt with a leaderboard. Its photo booth has since been integrated and used by PizzaDAO at its events.

  • Thermo

    A free Mac app that shows CPU, GPU, SSD and battery temperatures around the notch and tells you which app is heating your Mac, what's slowing down and what to close. Memory, battery-health and 24-hour history tabs, smart alerts, and no sudo or kernel extensions.

  • shipcrate

    Release and update tooling in one command: a quality gate with git hooks and CI, GitHub releases with SHA-256 checksums and provenance, a Homebrew formula, a verifying installer and update notices. Extracted from Thermo, with a Claude Code plugin and an MCP server for AI agents.
